_comment: Model lifecycle, refreshed deliberately rather than queried at check time so the check runs in CI without credentials and gives the same answer everywhere. Refresh it with the procedure in docs/model-lifecycle.md. A model absent from this table fails the check on purpose: adding one should be a decision, not an accident.
source: bedrock:ListFoundationModels, GetFoundationModel and GetFoundationModelAvailability, us-east-1, on 2026-10-11

amazon.nova-micro-v1:0.note: The brief flags Nova Micro as past its stated end-of-life floor. The Bedrock API reports ACTIVE and ON_DEMAND today, and the model card's support window has not been read yet, so eol_date stays null rather than guessed. Verifying it is the first item in the review cadence.

deepseek.v3.2.note: ON_DEMAND, so it survives the single-Region residency rule that disqualifies the inference-profile-only frontier models.

anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0.note: Inference-profile only. Verified with bedrock:GetFoundationModel on 2026-10-19, when the development deployment's tracked manifest named it as the analyst primary; the rest of the table was verified 2026-10-11. The provider reports it ACTIVE and it answers for this account.

anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:.note: LEGACY as reported by bedrock:GetFoundationModel on 2026-10-19. The development deployment's fallback named it until this change; the fallback chain now uses Haiku in a second Region and Nova Pro instead. Sonnet 5 is ACTIVE in the catalog but AccessDenied for this account, so the replacement is recorded rather than adopted, and enabling that access is a client installation step.

anthropic.claude-sonnet-5.note: Inference-profile only, so a single-Region requirement disqualifies it and the ON_DEMAND models are the fallback. The brief records no retention requirement on this model.

anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5.note: Inference-profile only. No retention requirement reported, which is what makes it usable for regulated work.

anthropic.claude-opus-5-5.note: Inference-profile only. Used by the hybrid example as the analyst's frontier tier.
